summary: ReNew Energy Global plc filed a Form 6-K announcing that its Nasdaq-listed warrants (RNWWW) will expire at 5:00 p.m. New York City time on August 22, 2026, per the Warrant Agreement dated August 23, 2021. The company will not extend the term, and no broker protect period has been established. Trading will be suspended on August 21, 2026, and the warrants delisted from Nasdaq; unexercised warrants will expire worthless. This is a routine corporate event warrant expiration notice. What to watch: any last-minute exercise activity and the subsequent delisting.
